title: TinyTaxiNet region-tagged verification: matched-dimension follow-up experiments

pca.method: all 256 z-box corners plus 5000 random feasible samples; not exact optimization

random_seed0.method: all 256 z-box corners plus 5000 random feasible samples; not exact optimization

random_seed1.method: all 256 z-box corners plus 5000 random feasible samples; not exact optimization

random_seed2.method: all 256 z-box corners plus 5000 random feasible samples; not exact optimization

exp1_P1_matched_dim_control.verdict: Random 8D affine region flips P1a/P1b to UNSAT like the AE decoder box: the flip is a generic low-dimensional-region effect, not decoder-support-specific. The validation search shows the regions are non-degenerate; the exact UNSAT verdicts prove the 10 m bound is not reachable.

exp2_P3_dimension_sweep.verdict: PCA verification collapses with dimension (100% at d=2 to ~27% at d=64) while a matched random subspace stays ~100%: at the operating point d=8 they nearly agree (dimensionality dominates), but direction becomes decisive at d>=16. Timeouts reported, not counted as verified.

exp3_pgd_vs_marabou.verdict: The cheap subspace attack finds 0 of the Marabou-SAT witnesses (all missed), attack_only=0 (sound), and Marabou certifies UNSAT where attack failure is inconclusive: formal solving is decisive.

support_LARD_verdict: Both PCA and random remove all LARD broad witnesses (100% UNSAT) at every d 2-64: matched sigma-scale keeps witnesses off the data manifold at any dimension.

support_scale_calibration.verdict: PCA and random share identical z-box volume and L2 reach (gap=0); the random control is matched, not secretly smaller (its effective pixel footprint is equal or larger).

support_closed_loop_P4.verdict: P4 wrong-sign washes out (0% departures) while a systematic always-flip diverges (66%): the mode is real but marginal/transient, and does not destabilize a simple proportional controller.

support_frontier.verdict: At d=8 PCA captures 91.3% of held-out data variance vs random 6.0%: equal verification, opposite data coverage; verification rate alone does not certify realism.
